sentences.text: Justin Hotard has been President and Chief Executive Officer of Nokia Oyj since 1 April 2025, appointed by the board as successor to Pekka Lundmark, who stayed on as an adviser through the end of that year; he brought more than 25 years of experience at global technology companies and is based at Nokia's headquarters in Espoo, Finland.

sentences.quote: Intel Corporation today announced the appointment of Justin Hotard as executive vice president and general manager of its Data Center and AI Group (DCAI), effective Feb. 1.
sentences.text: Immediately before Nokia he was executive vice president and general manager of Intel's Data Center and AI Group, a role he took up in February 2024, having previously led High-Performance Computing, AI and Labs at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, including its Hewlett Packard Labs research arm.

sentences.quote: Nokia is simplifying its operational model into two primary operating segments of Network Infrastructure and Mobile Infrastructure. These changes are intended to put Nokia on a stronger path to innovate
sentences.text: At its November 2025 Capital Markets Day Nokia set a new strategy under CEO Justin Hotard, simplifying the operating model into two primary segments, Network Infrastructure and Mobile Infrastructure, and targeting annual comparable operating profit of EUR 2.7-3.2 billion by 2028.

sentences.quote:
Nokia plans to move the following units into Portfolio Businesses:
Fixed Wireless Access CPE (currently in Fixed Networks in Network Infrastructure)
sentences.text: Hotard also placed four units, including private wireless, under review, with sales to be pursued in 2026.

Leadership changes followed: Raghav Sahgal took the new chief customer officer role and Tommi Uitto left the team at the end of December; Kristen Pressner started as Chief People Officer on 1 April 2026, and Emma Falck, from Siemens, became President of Mobile Infrastructure on 1 September 2026, a unit Hotard had led on an interim basis.
